hooks.name: Rebuild after package metadata changes
hooks.description: Builds only the affected package when its setup.py, setup.cfg, package.xml or CMakeLists.txt is saved.

action.prompt: A package build file (setup.py, setup.cfg, package.xml or CMakeLists.txt) was just saved. Run `colcon build --symlink-install --packages-select <that package>` with ROS sourced and report errors only, or a one-line success. If a console script was added or removed, confirm it appears under install/<package>/lib/<package>/.
